Role Overview   Salesforce is seeking an experienced  Senior Technical Program Manager  to lead programs and projects within the IT Delivery Services organization. This is role would be supporting programs within the IT Experience Engineering sub-pillar. The initiatives in this area involve the following:   Endpoint engineering and device management  Enterprise productivity and collaboration platforms (Google Workspace/GSuite and related tools)  IT Service Management (ITSM) and ServiceNow ecosystem improvements  AI-powered workforce productivity solutions and enterprise automation  Digital workplace technologies  IT operations     As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in leading all aspects of and coordinating multiple large scale, complex and cross-org programs and projects. TPMs are responsible for leading programs and projects from beginning to end, ensuring cross-team coordination and collaboration, detailed execution and delivery of work, and effective communication. They work closely with executives, product management, engineering, vendors, and many more to drive critical programs and projects activities. This role requires strong leadership abilities, excellent executive communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. This is an individual contributor role.     Role Responsibilities      Manage programs/projects through the entire program/project lifecycle. Ensure that business leads and technical teams are on track with their work as they are responsible and accountable for execution.  Work closely with product management, engineering, and cross-functional teams, to support the development of the scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, and timing for new initiatives.  Engage with senior leaders and stakeholders to track and gain stakeholder alignment and sign-off/approvals on the programs status and deliverable dates.  Identify and manage program risks, issues, and dependencies, and develop mitigation and contingency plans as needed. Collaborate with other TPMs to manage across the program.  Drive program meetings to help make key decisions, remove obstacles, and address key program issues. Be the key driver to ensure business goals are met and drive the strategic vision forward in partnership with the business area (domain) leader.  Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation including maintaining and posting status reports and other critical program documents.  Drive continuous improvement and proactively consolidate/iterate on approach.  Coordinate leadership readout on program status (issues, risks, metrics, key decisions, etc.)  Maintain and implement program governance standards and processes to optimize project delivery predictability, transparency, and agility. Drive continuous improvements based on lessons learned and industry best practices.  Ensure deliverables are aligned across contributing teams for projects and programs  Provide program specific knowledge transfer as new members are added to the program  Drive cross functional program priorities  Coordinate handoffs of program deliverables  Drive program retrospectives upon closure and after completion of critical milestones  Partner with Product Management for alignment of program requirements and business need  Support PI Planning (for SAFe driven engagements), and other work planning efforts to synthesize outputs into appropriate program materials  Coordinate project/program interdependencies between the various projects and programs in the portfolios  Identify program budget needs and work with portfolio management to do quarterly forecasting and tracking budget and reporting.      Skills & Requirements      Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and collaborate with diverse stakeholders at all levels of the organization.  Experience in implementing and managing cross-functional programs/projects.  Effective in influencing high-quality decisions, solving and/or escalating issues, and meeting deadlines.  Ability to juggle multiple large-scaled programs/projects.  Ability to establish credibility and rapport with senior executives, technical and non-technical team members alike.  Flexibility in shifting direction quickly when priorities change; excellent multi-tasking skills.  Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, process-driven mindset, and resourcefulness  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including sound judgment about, when,  Analytical thinker who is willing to make decisions cross-functionally in a fast-paced, dynamic environment  Self-starter; willing to dig in and get the job done with minimal guidance  Strong knowledge of leveraging AI tools to create delivery management efficiencies.    Required Experience     7+ years of Technical Program Management experience in a highly matrixed in environment (i.e. Senior Technical Program Manager, Senior Technical Project Manager)  Minimum of 3+ years executing technical programs/projects in a hybrid delivery model (Waterfall & Agile)  Must have exposure to managing programs in an agile model (ie Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)  Project Management Professional (PMP) certification  Agile certifications (ie.
